source.note: Search summary 2026-10-03 of the official conditions page: 39 alpine trails, 2 terrain parks (Challenger, Shooting Star) and 7 lifts — Comet Express and Galaxy Express (high-speed quads), Morning Star quad, Rocket Triple, Sunset Double, and Lunar Launch surface lifts #1 and #2. skiresort.info: 20 km of slopes (6 km easy 30%, 10 km intermediate 50%, 4 km difficult 20%), 5 lifts (chairs) totalling 9,700/h. features.beginnerArea: Launching Pad learning area served by a magic carpet; beginner lesson tickets are limited to the Lunar Launch and Sunset Chair

source.note: Night lighting reported on ~97% of trails (third-party summary). On-mountain lodging left unknown: the research only saw a 'ski & stay' page. Childcare (18 months-12 years) appeared in an unattributed summary — unconfirmed.

character: Compact Finger Lakes ski area south of Canandaigua with about 1,200 ft (366 m) of vertical, large for western New York, on terrain that is fairly steep for the region. Snowmaking covers the whole mountain, most trails are lit for night skiing, and it hosts race and aerials training.
learning: Beginners start at the Launching Pad, a separate learning zone with a magic carpet. Beginner-only 2-hour group lessons run on weekends and holidays at 10am and 1pm; the package bundles a 4-hour lift ticket restricted to the Lunar Launch and Sunset Chair plus a 4-hour rental.

source.note: Opened Sat Dec 6, 2025 (weekends only at first, Comet Express with 3 trails; daily from mid-December). Closed Thu Apr 2, 2026 after 111 operating days per RochesterFirst (https://www.rochesterfirst.com/news/business/local-business/bristol-mountains-2025-26-season-comes-to-a-close/).

season.typicalText: Opened Sat Dec 6, 2025 (weekends at first, daily from mid-December) and on a Thursday around Nov 30, 2023 for its 59th season (date inferred from article dates); the 2024-25 opening date was not found. The 2025-26 season closed Thu Apr 2, 2026 after 111 operating days.
season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening date found as of 2026-10-03. OnTheSnow (third party) projects 2026-12-11 opening; a projection, not an announcement (https://www.onthesnow.com/new-york/bristol-mountain/ski-resort).
